04-bee-swarm-census.visual_critic_note: Deliberately designed with a colorblind-safe Tol palette, meaningful percentile reference lines, marginal box plot, and leader-line callouts, but the subtitle text visually collides with the P25/P50/P75 labels and the top-earner callout for 'Sam Q.' is clipped at the right edge due to an undersized right margin.
04-bee-swarm-census.encoding_integrity_note: Log scale is appropriate for skewed income data, dot size is fixed (no area-encoding lie factor), box plot statistics are data-derived, and percentile annotations are computed from data — but the xScale domain [14000, 550000] is hardcoded rather than derived via d3.extent/d3.max, limiting metamorphic robustness.
04-bee-swarm-census.stress_test_note: Static pre-computed swarm with only pointer-event tooltips; no brush, zoom, transitions, cross-view dispatch, or separate mouse/touch handlers means none of the five interaction traps apply.
04-bee-swarm-census.cognitive_load_note: Single view, 4-category colorblind-safe palette, and pre-computed swarm layout keep 400 dots readable; minor crowding where top-earner callout labels stack near the P90 line, but overall structure and hierarchy are clear.
